jobs.name: LeviathanRibs
jobs.prompt: Stylized low-poly game asset, flat-shaded facets, bold clean colors, slightly realistic proportions, in the style of a cozy underwater adventure game: one segment of a colossal ancient sea serpent's skeleton: a single huge bone vertebra at the top with a pair of long thick curved ribs sweeping out and down from both sides, together forming a tall rounded archway like an upside-down U, pale weathered bone white with grey cracks, small cyan glowing tube worms growing in clusters on the bone. Chunky faceted. A single object, symmetric, standing upright as an arch, no water, no seabed, no text.
jobs.negative_prompt: photo, realistic, blurry, scene, background, ground plane, water, multiple objects, text, pink, peach, beige, cream, skin, flesh, people, skeleton of a person
